scenario.title: Credential tampering escalates with notification and audit log instead of silent degradation
steps: CredentialTamperedError in getSessionToken sets authState to tampered
CredentialTamperedError in getSessionToken invokes onCredentialTampered callback
CredentialTamperedError in getSshKeyPassphrase sets authState to tampered
CredentialTamperedError in getSshKeyPassphrase invokes onCredentialTampered callback
Renderer displays tampered auth state with security warning label
NotificationService dispatches OS notification on tampering
Security audit log persists tampering events separately

assertions.description: getSessionToken catches CredentialTamperedError and sets authState to tampered
getSessionToken invokes onCredentialTampered callback on tampering
getSshKeyPassphrase catches CredentialTamperedError and sets authState to tampered
getSshKeyPassphrase invokes onCredentialTampered callback on tampering

prMarkdown:
## Visual Evidence — #338 Credential Tamper Escalation

**Status**: ✅ Passed

All 19 credential-vault tests pass. Typecheck and comment-ratio gates pass.

### Assertions
- ✅ `getSessionToken` sets authState to `tampered` (not `blocked`)
- ✅ `getSessionToken` invokes `onCredentialTampered` callback
- ✅ `getSshKeyPassphrase` sets authState to `tampered` (not `blocked`)
- ✅ `getSshKeyPassphrase` invokes `onCredentialTampered` callback

### Files changed
- `src/shared/ipc.ts` — added `"tampered"` to `EnvironmentAuthState`, `SecurityAuditEvent`, `CredentialBridge`
- `src/main/config-store.ts` — callback hook + tampered state
- `src/main/security-audit-log.ts` — persistent audit log
- `src/main/index.ts` — wire callback to NotificationService + audit log + IPC
- `src/main/ipc-validation.ts` — credential:getSecurityAuditEvents validation
- `src/preload/index.ts` — credential bridge (onTampered, getSecurityAuditEvents)
- `src/renderer/src/components/InstanceSettingsPanel.tsx` — tampered auth state label
- `src/renderer/src/i18n/en.json` — authStateTampered i18n key
- `tests/credential-vault.test.ts` — updated assertions + callback tests
